chat.title: Plan it in the group chat · Yakın Çevrem

couples.title: Couples planner app · Yakın Çevrem
couples.description: Shared plans, memories, photo days and games you play at the same time; a space just for the two of you.

trust.title: Privacy and control: who sees what · Yakın Çevrem

features.title: All features: schedules, plans, projects · Yakın Çevrem
features.description: Shared schedules, finding free time, meetup polls, live meetups, the Agenda, projects and guided tools, chat stored encrypted and the couple space; all in one list.
